subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

A mother has / a greatest / influence / over the children.
solution:
The correct answer is **A greatest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'A greatest'** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct usage is **'the greatest' **instead of '**a greatest.'**
 
• Unique nouns are paired with the definite article **the**. When the noun is modified with a superlative (such as best or greatest), the noun becomes a unique noun. 

The correct sentence is: **A mother has the greatest influence over the children. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The indefinite articles are a and an.
 
• **A **is used before a singular noun beginning with a consonant sound.
 
• **An** is used before a singular noun beginning with a vowel sound.
